points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: Immutable 1b164486 clean CMake build passes with warnings in network-disabled cfd-bench (2 CPUs, 3 GiB); no solver rerun.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: main.cpp:55–63 parses --restart but never invokes try_read_restart; case/output parsing is present.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: Source separates mesh reader/local partition, reconstruction, solver, force and output components.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: No affirmative wrapper or copied open-source core evidence found in inspected source; case outputs explicitly reused a sibling and are separately assessed.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: Case JSON selects mesh and physics; no two-filename-only branch found in source.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: main.cpp:93–125 root-preprocesses METIS partitions and solver.cpp:238–258 uses neighbor halo and reductions; own-solver rank result evidence is absent.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: solver.cpp:422–430,533 unconditionally labels exhausted steady/transient loops successful; restart input is ignored.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: Clean build passes; selected final admits all case results came from sibling, so structural validator cannot validate this solver’s own physics.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Separated components with explicit comments; unconditional status and unused restart reader undermine behavioral reliability.

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: Conservative perfect-gas Rusanov, Newtonian/heat and BDF source paths exist, though own case evidence is absent.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: mesh_reader.cpp and partition.cpp read unstructured CGNS and call METIS; main.cpp scopes global mesh on root before loading rank-local data.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: solver.cpp:135–160 accumulates face residuals and viscous terms; no independent end-to-end own-solver results establish correctness.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: solver.cpp uses Rusanov and report.tex:32 describes it correctly; solver has no production validation from its own final cases.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: solver.cpp contains exact wall pressure and no-slip/farfield branches; independent own-solver case evidence is missing.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: Least-squares reconstruction exists, but solver.cpp:145 sets ghost-side limiter to zero and exchanges state only, limiting partition-boundary order.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: solver.cpp:75–108 applies Barth-type bounds and positivity fallback to owned cells; ghost-side limiter defaults zero.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: Newtonian/heat face path exists; forces.cpp:72–80 explicitly projects wall traction tangentially. No reliable own-solver case validation.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: LU-SGS steady loop exists; solver.cpp:422–430 unconditionally marks max-step exhaustion converged, and no own case converged evidence was delivered.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: solver.cpp:438–533 has BDF2/inner target path, but :508–513 overwrites previous time level after bootstrap and :533 labels all horizons periodic; no own Re200 result.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: METIS, root-only global preprocessing, local mesh, state halos and reductions exist; submitted rank/result files are from sibling and do not validate this solver.

points.title: Output contract compliance
points.notes: All eight final output sets are byte-identical to sibling 03 and terminal response confirms reuse; no own-solver final case evidence is established.

points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: Original validator structurally passed submitted case files and report; those files are sibling-produced and cannot establish this solver’s completion.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: Eight required own-solver final cases are not evidenced; sibling case matrix was reused.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: Sibling numerical histories cannot demonstrate physical accuracy of this solver; Re20 copied history itself violates stable-force plateau.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: Five-page PDF has six Mach/pressure pairs and 41 standalone figures exist, but they depict sibling results; no own-solver visualization establishes requested cases.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: Report gives equations and methods but blank force table, missing history/wake coverage and undisclosed provenance in report itself; final response admits sibling reuse.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: Manifest and figures exist but map to sibling-copied case files, so they do not trace to runs of the submitted solver.

sections.title: Build, CLI, Output Contract
sections.notes: Immutable clean build passes; case/output CLI exists, but parsed restart is never consumed and own final case outputs are absent.

sections.title: Mesh And Geometry
sections.notes: CGNS root preprocessing and METIS local partition are implemented; no independent solver-produced mesh/run validation.

sections.title: Finite-Volume Residual And Boundary Conditions
sections.notes: Conservative face residual, Rusanov and wall/farfield paths exist; own physical case evidence is missing.

sections.title: Second-Order Spatial Scheme
sections.notes: Least-squares and Barth path exists, but ghost face side uses zero limiter and only state is exchanged; no own order validation.

sections.title: Viscous Terms
sections.notes: Newtonian/heat and tangential wall-shear integration exist in source, without valid own case evidence.

sections.title: Implicit And Transient Methods
sections.notes: LU-SGS and BDF2 paths exist, but steady/transient success is unconditional, first BDF2 step loses the initial prior level, and no own Re200 evidence.

sections.title: MPI
sections.notes: METIS and neighbor state halo/reductions exist with root-only global preprocessing; no own rank-comparison results and partition reconstruction is one-sided.

sections.title: Case Results And Validation
sections.notes: Selected final admits sibling case matrix; eight case histories and status files match sibling byte-for-byte, so no own result completion credit.

sections.title: Report, Visualization, Analysis
sections.notes: Report supplies method text and selected field plots, but blank force table and imported sibling figures do not establish own solver results.

sections.title: Extensibility
sections.notes: Separated modules support some extension but are specialized to 2-D ideal gas and incomplete restart/status paths.

No synthetic-history inference is established.

The selected final explicitly states sibling results completed the case matrix; these are not evidence of a completed run by this submitted solver.
